name: 波多西
evolution: 多西 → 库多西 Lv.32 → 波多西 Lv.48
description: 能将钢铁之力积蓄于双爪中，使出蓄力重击，威力十足。以地底的粗矿为食，精炼过的钢铁对它而言似乎有着不同寻常的风味。在它出没的地方，常有铁锅失窃。
descriptionEn: It can store the power of steel in its twin claws, unleashing a charged heavy strike with tremendous force. It feeds on crude ore from the earth, and refined steel seems to have an unusual flavor to it. Where it appears, iron pots often go missing.

skills.name: 啮合传递
skills.description: 自己获得速度+30，本技能位于1号或3号位时额外获得物攻+80%，传动1。
skills.descriptionEn: Gains Speed+30; when this skill is in slot 1 or 3, additionally gains Attack+80%, transmission 1.

skills.name: 能量守恒
skills.description: 减伤80%，应对攻击：两侧技能能耗永久-1。
skills.descriptionEn: Damage reduction 80%; when responding to an attack: both adjacent skills' energy cost permanently -1.

skills.name: 齿轮扭矩
skills.description: 造成物伤，每回合位置发生变化时，本技能威力永久+15。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; each turn the position changes, this skill's power permanently +15.

skills.name: 轴承支撑
skills.description: 主动：本技能被动永久额外-1能耗，被动：两侧技能能耗-1，传动1。
skills.descriptionEn: Active: this skill's passive gains permanent extra -1 energy cost; passive: both adjacent skills' energy cost -1, transmission 1.

skills.name: 鸣沙陷阱
skills.description: 造成物伤，物防比敌方越高，本次技能威力越高。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; the higher your Defense compared to the enemy, the higher this skill's power.

skills.name: 壁垒
skills.description: 减伤90%，应对攻击：防御技能冷却-1。
skills.descriptionEn: Damage reduction 90%; when responding to an attack: defense skill cooldown -1.

skills.name: 钢钻
skills.description: 造成物伤，技能威力为两侧技能威力和的三分之一，传动1。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; skill power equals one third of the sum of both adjacent skills' power, transmission 1.

skills.name: 齿轮切开
skills.description: 造成物伤，本技能位于1号或3号位时能耗-2，传动1。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; when in slot 1 or 3 energy cost -2, transmission 1.

skills.name: 岩土暴击
skills.description: 造成物伤，每被攻击1次。本技能能耗永久-1。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; each time attacked, this skill's energy cost permanently -1.

skills.name: 地震
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成物理伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage to the enemy.

skills.name: 地刺
skills.description: 造成物伤，应对状态：额外打断被应对技能。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; when responding to a status: additionally interrupts the responded skill.
